'''Thromrar Darkflame''' is a [[skardyn]] located in the [[Tomb of Ancestors]] in the [[Grim Reaches]].

Thromrar is the source of the corruption seeping through the [[Grim Hollow]], having ensnared the minds of the Red dragonkin that patrol the swamp and raised the fallen ancestors of the Wildhammer through dark magic. [[Sarthyss Scaleheart]] wants Thromrar dead to lift the taint on the land.
